fullTextZH: 在上一个视频我说了我在悉尼没有很多很多朋友，
fullTextEN: In the last video, I said I don't have many friends in Sydney,
but I am very busy every day,

fullTextZH: 所以今天我要比一比我在中国的爱好和我在澳大利亚的爱好。
fullTextEN: so today I want to compare my hobbies in China and in Australia.

fullTextZH: 在中国的时候我喜欢去卡拉 OK ，
fullTextEN: When I was in China, I liked to go to karaoke,

fullTextZH: 我喜欢去 KTV 唱歌，
fullTextEN: I like to go to KTV to sing,
I really like to go singing,

fullTextZH: 所以我常常和我的朋友去唱歌。
fullTextEN: so I often go singing with my friends.

fullTextZH: 我觉得在中国 KTV 很便宜，
fullTextEN: I think KTV in China is very cheap,

fullTextZH: 所以我和我的朋友去唱歌。
fullTextEN: So my friends and I went to sing.

fullTextZH: 每次我们唱 6 个小时，
fullTextEN: Every time we sing for 6 hours,

fullTextZH: 我们都会一起唱一首歌，
fullTextEN: We all sing a song together,

fullTextZH: 最难最难的歌是一首中文歌，
fullTextEN: The hardest song is a Chinese song,

fullTextZH: 叫《死了都要爱》这首歌很高很高，
fullTextEN: Called 'Even If I Die, I Want to Love', this song is very high,

fullTextZH: 我们所有的人大声地唱，
然后我们的嗓子都哑了，
fullTextEN: Then our voices all became hoarse,

fullTextZH: 可是我们所有人都很开心，
fullTextEN: But all of us were very happy,
In China, I like singing the most,

fullTextZH: 我也喜欢和朋友去吃饭，
fullTextEN: I also like going out to eat with friends,

fullTextZH: 去街上看看衣服看看鞋子，
fullTextEN: going to the street to look at clothes and shoes,

fullTextZH: 我和我的朋友一边逛街一边聊天。
fullTextEN: My friends and I chat while shopping.
But I like singing the most,

fullTextZH: 在澳大利亚我也喜欢唱歌，
fullTextEN: In Australia, I also like singing,
but I don't often go to KTV,

fullTextZH: 因为澳大利亚的朋友不喜欢去 KTV，
fullTextEN: because my Australian friends don't like going to KTV,

fullTextZH: 所以我在我的家里唱歌。
可是我不去 KTV 唱歌。
fullTextEN: But I don't go to KTV to sing.

fullTextZH: 在澳大利亚我有了很多很多新的爱好，
fullTextEN: In Australia, I have many new hobbies,

fullTextZH: 我学习西班牙语和法语。
所以我觉得现在我每天都很忙很忙。
fullTextEN: So I think now I'm very busy every day.
but I'm very busy every day.
